value.rationale: A complete natural three-positive-parameter family is classified, including every input-set criterion, sharp weight-induced jumps in the minimum number of independent vertex inputs, two explicit nodal design obstructions, and formulas for every optimal placement. The asymmetry m-1 result beats the strong-structural zero-forcing guarantee m+1 without any input mixing; exact resonance m+1 is an analytically motivated boundary. These are useful constructive control-design facts, not a fixed-size table or a parameter renaming.
